Scientists warn that Super El Niño has morphed into Mega El Niño: What it means for Nigeria
Nigeria could face even tougher conditions as rising temperatures threaten water supply
Lagos may also experience reduced rainfall, and access to water may become harder for residents.
What is Nigeria’s fate?
By Akinjide Adebowale
